faqPage.title: Portal FAQ
faqPage.subtitle: Complete guide for the client portal: login, briefing, projects, billing, support, and account settings.

items.question: How do I access the portal?
items.answer: Use the link sent by email and sign in with your customer email. On first access, you may be asked to set your permanent password.

items.question: I forgot my password. What should I do?
items.answer: On the login screen, click 'Forgot your password?'. You will receive a reset link valid for 24 hours.

items.question: Which languages are available?
items.answer: The portal supports English, Portuguese, and Spanish. You can switch language from the selector in the top bar.

items.question: When does the briefing alert appear?
items.answer: The alert only appears while at least one project is in 'awaiting briefing' status. Once briefing is submitted, it disappears automatically.

items.question: What is shown in the invoice card?
items.answer: You can see invoice number/status, amount, and due date. If payment is pending, the pay button is available.

items.question: How do I open my site panel?
items.answer: In the 'Panel' card, click 'Open panel'. If your site is not provisioned yet, the card will show that status.

items.question: What information should I provide in briefing?
items.answer: Provide company name, services, city, WhatsApp, domain (if any), logo, preferred colors, and additional project details.

items.question: Can I attach files in briefing?
items.answer: Yes. You can attach logo files, photos, references, and any support material directly in the form.

items.question: What happens after submitting briefing?
items.answer: Your project moves forward for team review. You can track status and communicate in the projects area.

items.question: How do I track project progress?
items.answer: Go to 'Projects', open your project, and follow pipeline, files, messages, and modification requests.

items.question: How do I upload files to a project?
items.answer: Inside project details, use the files section to upload logos, images, content files, or references.

items.question: How does the revision limit work?
items.answer: Each plan includes a revision limit. The portal shows how many requests were used in the month and how many remain.

items.question: Where can I see my invoices?
items.answer: Open 'Billing' to view full history, filter by status, and open each invoice details.

items.question: How do I pay a pending invoice?
items.answer: Click 'Pay' on the invoice row/card. You will be redirected to the configured payment flow.

items.question: Can I download my invoice?
items.answer: Yes. Use 'Download / Print invoice' to open a printable version and save as PDF.

items.question: How do I open a support ticket?
items.answer: Go to 'Support', click 'New Ticket', fill subject and message, then submit.

items.question: How do I reply to an existing ticket?
items.answer: Open the ticket from support list and post your reply in the message box.

items.question: Where do I see new notifications?
items.answer: Open 'Notifications'. You also see unread badges in the sidebar when new items arrive.

items.question: How do I update my profile information?
items.answer: On 'Profile', edit name, phone, and address, then save changes.

items.question: Can I change my login email?
items.answer: Not directly from portal for security reasons. If needed, open a support ticket requesting the change.

items.question: How do I change my password?
items.answer: On 'Profile' > 'Security', enter current password and a new one. If you forgot it, use reset from login.
